hints.content:
$\displaystyle \lim_{x\to -7}h(x)$ represents the limit of $h$ as $x$ approaches $-7$.

Let's look at the table and see if the $h(x)$-values seem to approach a distinct value as the $x$-values approach $-7$.

$x$ | $h(x)$
-: | :- 
$-7.1$| $-3.32$
$-7.01$| $-3.1$
$-7.001$| $-3.03$

As the $x$-values *increase towards* $x=-7$ (i.e. approach it from the left), the $h(x)$-values seem to approach $-3$.

$x$ | $h(x)$
-: | :-
$-6.999$| $-3.03$
$-6.99$| $-3.1$
$-6.9$| $-3.32$

As the $x$-values *decrease towards* $x=-7$ (i.e. approach it from the right), the $h(x)$-values seem to approach $-3$.

question.content:
The function $h$ is defined over the real numbers. This table gives a few values of $h$.

$x$ | $h(x)$
-: | :-
$-7.1$| $-3.32$
$-7.01$| $-3.1$
$-7.001$| $-3.03$
$-6.999$| $-3.03$
$-6.99$| $-3.1$
$-6.9$| $-3.32$

**What is a reasonable estimate for $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to -7}h(x)$?**
